## What’s new

- **Filter by label:** Search now completes matching labels and pins them as colored filters. Combine several labels with free text to narrow the task list precisely.
- **Browse every picture:** The image lightbox now fits each picture, steps through every picture in a task, keeps prepared images cached, and holds the current picture on screen while the terminal resizes.

Release-managed installations can update with `/update`. Cargo-managed installations should run:

```sh
cargo install --locked mach-tui
```

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/Q1CHENL/mach/compare/v0.11.0...v0.12.0
